Priya: Quick help needed — final loop for candidate Riya Shen (SWE IC4). Candidate is in PST, available Tue/Thu next week 9am–1pm PST. Can someone own scheduling and logistics?
Jordan L: I can own scheduling. Will coordinate panel times.
Sam Patel: I’ll confirm panelist availability. Who do we want on the loop?
Jordan L: Hiring panel = me + Sam + Maya K + Eng lead (Asha). Two 45m interviews + 30m bar raiser.
Maya K: I’ll reserve a quiet room and request a laptop loaner if she comes onsite. Which office?
Priya: Candidate prefers SF office. Need a badge, parking pass + rideshare stipend ($50) if she chooses to come in. Also send NDA link and interview packet.
Maya K: facilities-bot says rm-3C available Tue 10:30–1:30 and Thu 9–12. I submitted a loaner request for a MacBook Pro (pending approval).
facilities-bot: Badge request created: BADGE-8742. Parking pass requested for 2 hours at SF-visitor level.
Jordan L: Ok locking Tue 10:30am PST for on-site (panel Asha + Jordan). Sam — can you do Thu 11am as fallback?
Sam Patel: Thu 11 works for me as fallback. I’ll ping Asha now.
Priya: Interview packet: https://redwood-hr.s3/interview-packs/riya-shen-final.zip (includes role doc, scoring rubric, and test prompt). Please use the rubric for calibration.
Jordan L: Sending calendar invites now. Will include interview-bot note with prep and rubric.
interview-bot: Calendar invites sent to panel + candidate. Candidate received scheduling options via Greenhouse.
Priya: Riya needs travel reimbursement form + rideshare voucher if she takes office. I’ll draft the reimbursement email.
Maya K: Loaner laptop hold placed at reception. Please confirm if candidate will come onsite so I can approve loaner pickup time.
Jordan L: Candidate tentatively chose in-person on Tue. I’ll confirm after Asha replies.
Sam Patel: Asha confirmed Tue 10:30. I’m marking my calendar.
Priya: Cool — I’ll send NDA (DocuSign) and parking QR. Also copying reimbursement form and stipend policy.
Priya: Quick checklist before we close: 1) calendar invites sent (Jordan) 2) room + loaner reserved (Maya) 3) badge/parking created (facilities-bot) 4) NDA + packet sent (Priya) 5) stipend email + form (Priya)
Jordan L: All good from scheduling side. I’ll follow up with candidate 24h before.
Maya K: Will email reception with loaner pickup code and hold laptop at 10:00am Tue.
Priya: Thanks team — I’ll close the loop once candidate signs NDA. :thumbsup:
Jordan L: Thanks!
Sam Patel: Thanks everyone.
